input.quote: Garman hereby grants to Sparkling, for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use: (i) the Software, safely in executable object code format, at each AS400 at each of the Authorized Locations; and (ii) the Documentation.
input.rationale: Garman owns all IP in the Work, including the Improvements and the Schedule "D" Modifications we pay for (§13), while our only right is a non-exclusive licence capped to Authorized Locations (§2), expressly non-sublicensable (§3(c)) and lasting only while fees are paid and the Agreement is not terminated (§17(a)). That fails the fallback licence-back position on its material terms: the licence is not perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide or royalty-free (extra fees apply for other locations) and carries no right to modify or sublicense for our business. Nothing limits Garman's use of our converted data (§4(b)). We therefore target fallback: Vendor ownership of the Work is preserved (already met at §13); we remove only the place-of-use cap and additional-fee sentence, keep "non-transferable" and the AS400 platform wording, and extend the grant to Improvements and Modifications so it reaches the deliverables we fund.

mappings.element: Vendor may retain ownership of generic tools and know-how.
mappings.quote: Garman is the owner of all intellectual property rights in the Work (including any Improvements or Modifications thereto), including all related materials, logos, and names provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement.

mappings.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is perpetual.
Customer's licence to Deliverables is irrevocable.
Customer's licence to Deliverables is worldwide.
Customer's licence to Deliverables is royalty-free.
Customer may use and modify Deliverables for its business.
Customer may sublicense Deliverables for its business.
Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.

proposal.summary: Make the §2 licence perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide and royalty-free with rights to use, modify and sublicense the Software (including Improvements and Modifications) and Documentation, conform the §3(c) sublicence bar, and limit Garman's use of our data to providing the services.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Garman keeps ownership of the Work, but our licence must be perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free and extend to modifying and sublicensing the Software (including Improvements and Modifications) and Documentation for our business, so we have removed the Authorized-Locations place-of-use cap and additional-fee sentence and deleted the conflicting sublicence bar in Section 3(c). We have also confirmed that any licence to Garman in our data is limited to processing it solely to provide the services.

Sparkling's right, if any, to use the Software and Documentation at locations other than the Authorized Locations is subject to the payment of additional fees in accordance with the Fee Schedule.
